events.label: Brookings testimony on China-related medicine supply-chain risks

slots.name: prescription adult share
slots.sentence: More than 60% of U.S. adults take at least one prescription drug, and roughly one in four take four or more.

slots.name: generic dispensing share
slots.sentence: In retail and mail‑order settings, generics account for over 90% of prescriptions dispensed, even though they make up only a fraction of overall drug spending.

slots.name: generic pills consumed
slots.sentence: In 2024 alone, Americans took roughly 187 billion generic tablets and capsules—about 550 pills per person—covering routine treatments for hypertension, diabetes, depression, infections, and many other conditions.

slots.name: CHIPS funding
slots.sentence: Through the CHIPS and Science Act of 2022, Congress has committed $52.7 billion in direct incentives and research funding to revitalize domestic semiconductor manufacturing

slots.name: oral solid India share
slots.sentence: For generic oral solid doses in 2024, India accounts for about 61% of the volume dispensed in U.S. pharmacies, the United States for roughly 22%, and the European Union for about 5%, while China supplied around 3.5%.

slots.name: sterile injectable U.S. share
slots.sentence: In contrast, for generic sterile injectables in 2024, the U.S. led with 42%, India supplied 21%, Europe 13%, and China 12%.

slots.name: China API volume share
slots.sentence: In my recent work, I find that Chinese‑produced active ingredients are included in perhaps a quarter of the generic drug unit volume sold in the United States

slots.name: China starting-material share
slots.sentence: A recent study suggests that nearly 41% of key starting materials used in U.S.‑approved active ingredients are sole-sourced from China.

slots.name: statin users
slots.sentence: Statins are a great example of a political-headache drug: about 90 million Americans use them

slots.name: Chinese API tariff
slots.sentence: Right now, there is a 10% tariff on products that use Chinese‑sourced active ingredients
